verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state Atlas obtains the company's federal EIN from the IRS as part of the incorporation process, and multiple pages reference pre-EIN and post-EIN states (e.g., banking eligibility before EIN arrives), confirming this is a core, documented feature. Community reviews corroborate a smooth overall incorporation/tax setup experience without disputing EIN issuance specifically. Missing for 10: independent verification of EIN turnaround time or any hands-on account of the EIN step itself.
